text:
sara: Hi team — day 3 onboarding q: I'm trying to build a compact "shadow" sheet for new hires that maps who to ping for VPC peering, private deploys, canary rollouts, and who to escalate to across timezones. Any concise guidance?

kai: Welcome! Short mapping works well. Eng-infra owns VPC peering & low-level creds; eng-platform owns the private-deploy flow and gating; eng-runtime owns rollout tooling/canary infra; product + PMs own QA/approval decisions.

morgan: Add timezone notes: APAC customers -> prefer paging APAC oncall first (we have region-aware routing). For P1s page #eng-oncall (they route to the right regional responder). For operational ownership list the specific leads.

devon: Quick copyable sheet you can drop in the wiki:

```
Who-to-ping (one-liner):
- VPC peering / infra creds: @eng-infra (infra leads: Priya, Sam K)
- Private deploy orchestration: @eng-platform
- Canary rollouts / tooling: @eng-runtime (runtime lead: Alex R)
- Rollout policy / approval: @product + feature PM
- P1 (service impacting): page #eng-oncall + @eng-sre + runtime lead + product-lead
- P2 (canary/regression, rollback possible): page @eng-runtime & open "rollout-help" ticket
- Onboarding / baseline access: @people-ops
- Dedicated capacity / contracts: @sales-ops
- Security / data residency questions: @security-privacy
```

sara: Nice. Any differences in escalation for APAC vs NA? I want to note who to page after hours.

kai: Yes. We route pages to local oncall first. If it's outside APAC hours, page #eng-oncall which has escalation rules: primary -> regional secondary -> global SRE. We also include the runtime lead in the first two minutes for rollout-related outages.

morgan: Also: for canary regressions outside hours, if rollback is straightforward do it and then page runtime-oncall. If rollback fails, escalate to P1 immediately and follow the P1 runbook.

devon: Copyable P1 snippet you can paste into a page:

```
P1 PAGE:
SERVICE: <service-name>
SEVERITY: P1 - production impact
WHAT: canary caused widespread errors / increased error-rate > X%
ACTION NEEDED: immediate mitigation + rollback if safe
CONTACT: <your-name>
REGION: <region>
```

people-ops: Heads-up: we'll auto-provision baseline cloud access but not VPC peering rights. New hires must request peering via eng-infra ticket and include the runbook link. We'll add Sara to the onboarding contacts sheet.

oncall-bot: #eng-oncall escalation: primary -> regional secondary -> global-sre. Next rotation: 2026-04-01 00:00 UTC (primary: Morgan).

sara: This is great  saving to the wiki and will add timezone callouts. Thanks everyone! :wave:

kai: If you draft the sheet, drop it here and we'll quick-review. Also flag any PMs we should add for approvals.

morgan: welcome aboard Sara! ping if the people-ops invite doesn't land in 24h.
